question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution: TB Solution: The correct answer is** reality.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • **'reality'** means **the way life really is, not the way it may appear to be or how you would like it to be. (वास्‍तविकता, यथार्थ)** -Example: However, the harsh **reality **is simply that airlines are hugely expensive businesses to run. • "**reality**" is a **noun**. ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ • "**fantasy**" means situations that are not true, that you just imagine. • "**probability **" means something that is likely to happen. • "**possibility **" means the fact that something might exist or happen but is not likely to. Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in is 'reality' 45:Tf5a,
